config.plugin.name: pgoutput
config.slot.name: payments_slot
config._comment_decimal: precise keeps NUMERIC exact on the wire as a base64 unscaled integer. double would silently round money at the connector, before any of this project's code runs.
config._comment_tombstones: Tombstones are kept so a compacted topic can drop deleted keys. The decoder recognises and skips them rather than counting them as a second delete.
config._comment_heartbeat: Without heartbeats, a low-traffic table lets the replication slot's confirmed LSN stall, and Postgres retains WAL segments until the disk fills.
